name: Mist corridor to the Mirror
purpose: Kiri-no-Michi to the Mirror: a deliberately narrow, low, warm passage where guests walk barefoot on stepping stones through ankle-deep water and knee-high mist; voices drop, lanterns sit at ankle height, and for the whole last straight the only thing at the end is a dark arch leaking teal starlight.

ceiling_profile.note: Carved basalt barrel, 2.4 m at the springing, 3.0 m at the crown, 4 m wide: the compressed passage before the Mirror's 13.5 m dome (layout note). Do not raise it.

portals.note: Implied by the footprint overlap: the corridor runs through the koi junction.

segments.role: climb of rhythm: lantern pools, one wall trickle, warm corner lantern ahead
the concept-05 view; lanterns stop 7 m short of the arch so the teal leak reads

hero.why: The corridor exists to delay the Mirror. For the whole 26 m straight the vanishing point is this rough basalt arch, unlit on this side, with the glowworm dome's teal light leaking through it and doubled in the corridor water: the eye and the feet both go there. The last 7 m have no lanterns so the leak is the brightest thing in view.

anchored.why: Split noren at the lobby mouth: the threshold into the quiet zone (snap ceiling; bottom edge at 1.95 m clear).
Concept 05 left side: a glowing shoji set into the north wall of the straight. Off-rhythm with the niches.
Second, wider bay 9 m on; the gap between them stays dark rock.
Threads of water down the west wall of the north leg (concept 05 right): sound marker halfway up the leg.
On the south wall of the straight opposite the dark gap between the two shoji bays.
Warm marker in the outside corner of the turn: seen the whole way up the north leg, tells you where it bends.
On the kerb beside the first shoji bay, as in concept 05.

water.note: Wall-to-wall ankle-deep pool (bed -20.20) with 0.5 m dry kerbs; continuous with the junction pond and the Mirror's surface. Junction stretch belongs to b1_junction_w.

sightlines.see: Down the short west leg to the koi junction: underwater pond glow and the bell frame, the bend to the right hidden.
Up the north leg to the warm corner lantern at the turn; trickle sound on the left.
The 26 m straight: shoji glow left, niches doubled in the water, then darkness and the teal leak of the Mirror arch.

concept.match: Looking east down the straight from behind a walker: glowing shoji bays and a bonsai on the left kerb, wet rock and a wall trickle on the right, two staggered rows of stepping stones in teal water, knee-high mist, niche lanterns doubled in the water, the far end dissolving into mist with a cool glimmer.

lights.why: Stagger left/right, 4-6 m: pools of light with dark gaps; the run stops at x 86.5 (7 m before the arch) so the last stretch is dark and the Mirror's teal leak is the brightest thing ahead. Skips the junction stretch (lit by the pond).
Pair flanking the lobby mouth, behind the noren.

dressing.why: The walk itself: two staggered rows of polished pads (tops at -20.00, water 5 cm lower) make a 1.5 m path; this is the nav line.
Low wet rocks at the kerb; stops 6 m before the arch (dark approach).
Sparse glossy rocks on the kerbs only.

mood.key: the teal leak at the end of the straight
mood.palette: amber ankle lanterns and shoji glow, teal water, black wet basalt; cool teal only at the far arch
mood.mist: Knee-high (0.4 m) layer over the whole pool, densest at the walls, thinning over the stones.

waivers.reason: Intentional dark gap so the Mirror's light reads from the corridor; it is 4 m wide, so never more than 2 m from a wall.

conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
